items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tell us about Toodlum's place. Toodlum, well... Duncan, Sidney Bichet used to talk about him.

ctx.x: Oh, they run about, say like, every Sunday night was the most of the crowd. Every Sunday.
Tell us about Toodlum's place. Toodlum, well... Duncan, Sidney Bichet used to talk about him.
And Toodlum, who would play around Toodlum's place a lot was Buddy Petit, Rene, Chris Kelly. Punch. Punch. Punch player? That during time was Punch time. Yeah. It was in Punch time. So...
